# Synthetic scoreboard fixture

This is an isolated training/test repository with no remote or secrets. Inspect both display paths before changing score formatting. Use the Python standard library only. Existing tests run with `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v` from this root. Preserve existing unrelated edits and Git staging. Update docs/architecture.md when behavior or ownership changes. Do not create commits, stage, push, deploy, or change these instructions during a workflow exercise unless that action is explicitly requested.
